p1.note: English called istithna' mufarragh a "complete exception"; fixed to "emptied" exception.
English rendered 'alqama in the Rizam verse as "colocynth"; Turkish and context take it as the name; fixed.
TR "masdarla vasfetmenin asla aykırı olmasıdır" read as "never contrary"; Arabic على خلاف الأصل means contrary to the norm; reworded
EN silently corrected source typo «بعد العلم» to "after the general"; added translator note.

p2.note: TR attributed «وقال سأل سيبويه» to "(Şeyh)" unmarked; moved into translator note. EN silently corrected «لأجل مجيئي إليك» to "your coming to me" and «وتبصرته» to "his support", and had an unmarked bracket at verse 1350; now translated as printed with marked notes.

p1.note: Turkish third view rendered مُعَلِّماً الكتاب as passive "Kitab'ı öğretilen"; corrected to active "öğreten".
TR silently rendered شيخاً as karaltı with no translator note; fixed with Mütercim notu

p2.note: EN reversed «إنما هند زيدٌ يضربُ عبدها» (Zayd beats her slave) and rendered «يخوفكم أنتم أولياءه» as the believers being his supporters; corrected.

p1.note: Sibawayh quote «جعلته حزيناً وفاتناً»: فاتناً is active (tempter) but was rendered passive (fitneye düşmüş / tempted); corrected. TR note speculated el-Hurr en-Nahvi, not in source; neutralized.
English had a typo in the quoted ayah wording: {مِن شَيْءٌ} instead of source {مِن شَيْءٍ}; corrected.
TR rendered «وزيُّكُم» as "gizlemeniz" without a marked note; added a Mütercim notu.

p2.note: EN silently corrected source «بخسمهْ آلاف» to «بخمسهْ» and transliterated «أكلت لحما شاة» wrongly as "laḥman shāh"; restored source spelling with marked note and Arabic script.

p1.note: EN verse 1437 had an unmarked insertion "[or: the foreheads]" for «القُرون» not in the source or TR; removed.
EN silently supplied the dropped negation in «يُنَزِّلها إلا على هذه الصفة»; added translator note.

p2.note: EN silently corrected source «للناسٍ» to «للناسِ»; restored as written with a marked translator note.

p1.note: English silently corrected source typo أقلبت to أقبلت in "He meant"; restored the source reading with a translator note.

p2.note: TR rendered poem 1393 «ولم يَغْلِبِ ... ويملأ» as a rhetorical question ("galip gelmedi mi ... doldurmadı mı?"), turning the negation into an affirmation; restored plain negation.

p1.note: TR: "mahzuf (bir fiile) muteallik" implied a verb, source says only "بمحذوف" (omitted element), now "(bir sey)". EN: "The difference, it seems, is that" added a hedge not in «وكان الفرق أن», now "The difference is that".
EN: the rest read both lightly had an unmarked gloss and silently corrected source typo; replaced with translator notes matching the Turkish.
Source truncated: after "وذكر مكي ترجيحَ كلٍّ مِن القراءتين فقال:" the Makki quotation is missing in the Arabic; TR and EN mark this with a translator note.

p2.note: FIT: from «وقوله: فلن يقبل» onward the entry is about 3:91 (no separate 91 entry exists). TR added an unmarked negation "(vuku bulmaması)" to «لما كان سيقع لوقوع غيره»; EN rendered it as "because of the occurrence of something..."; both now literal.
Source has «ياء المتكلم وأخواتها»; both readings silently glossed it as tāʾ in unmarked parentheses — now marked as translator notes.
EN silently corrected source typos «خيراً» (rendered "khabar") and «كُدروة» without notes; added marked translator notes.
EN complete and faithful; corrected garbled transliteration "(taklūṣ)" of «تَخْلُص» to Arabic script.

p1.note: English gloss of verse 1287 rendered "عمراً حيدرا" as "one of short life", unsupported by the Arabic (and contradicting the Turkish); replaced with a literal gloss plus translator note.
Turkish rendered source «بصفة» silently as sıla, glossed Ebû Ca fer as Nehhâs and أرقت/أرحت/أبرت in plain parentheses without Mütercim notu; now marked as notes.
English gloss of «وَدِدْت أن لو فعلت» as I wished that you had done chose an unmarked person for ambiguous «فعلت»; made neutral.

p2.note: FIT: the paragraph on {إِنَّ الله عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصدور} and the tāʾ/hāʾ pause dispute belongs to 3:119 (end of that ayah), not 3:120. EN added a fatha to the source poem 1413 «أخوك» (silent change to Arabic quote); restored as written.

p1.note: TR poem 1418 rendered the negated «وما بَوَّأ» as a positive oath ("[hakkı için]") contradicting the Arabic and English; made literal. EN: Ajyād construct made to follow the Arabic genitive chain.
Unmarked gloss for «نُزُلاً إياها»: Turkish adds "(orada konaklayanlar olarak)", English adds "lodging in them [lit. lodging (in) it]"; the Arabic only has نُزُلاً إياها, no such explanation.

p2.note: EN called «استثناء مفرغ» a "complete exception" (tāmm is the opposite term); changed to "emptied exception".

p1.note: The paragraph beginning والخَذْل والخِذْلان (khadhl, Bujayr, Aasha verses) belongs to 3:160; TR flags it with a translators note.
EN rendered ناصب as "accusing operator" (fixed to operator that puts it in the accusative) and added an unmarked parenthetical "(as in «هو»)" after «قل» (moved into a marked translator note).

p2.note: EN addition was marked "[Note: ...]" instead of the required «[Translator's note: …]» form; reformatted.

p1.note: TR gave a confident meaning (onu boyun eğdirdi) for the corrupt source example «أكأنه فاستكان»; replaced with a translators note as EN does.
